conventions: Players are named by role. The table of players gives each role its player number; where an order matters the case says "player n".
A layout is a starting draw. Every assignment with at most five players in a room is a legal one.
Turns are taken in order of player number in every round, unless the case gives another order.
Nobody acts, moves or votes unless the case says so. A vote without stated ballots jails or elects nobody.
"The vote jails X" means: enough ballots name X, and X alone has the most. With everybody voting that is 4 of 7, 4 of 8, 5 of 9.
Commands are named by what they do. Backend allocates their real names with the version.
Times are the server's. An interval [a, b) contains a and does not contain b.
V is the commit that closes the Jail vote, W the commit that closes its result and opens the window, X the commit that closes the window and resolves the round.
"Selects slot n" is the Disabler's selection, in darkness, of position n of the room their request is bound to.

cases.title: The window runs in a round in which nobody asked for a Blackout
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. No Blackout is requested.
sequence: The turns end.
The Jail vote closes at V and jails nobody.
Result, window, resolution.

state: Nobody changes health, room or slot between V and the next round.
No Blackout use is spent: both Disablers keep theirs.
visibility: Every seat, the host and the shared display get the same phase and the same lighting in every room.
No seat is offered a selection.
No payload says, or lets anyone work out, that nobody had asked.
timing: Result [V, V + 5 s). Window from W ≥ V + 5 s: lit [W, W + 5 s), dark [W + 5 s, W + 15 s). The round resolves at X ≥ W + 15 s.
The window is neither skipped nor shortened.

cases.title: One request, one hit: the table sees the same window as with none
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout. It names nobody.
The turns end. The Jail vote closes at V and jails nobody.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3, where Undercover stood at the snapshot.
The window ends. The round resolves.

state: Undercover: Injured, in Hospital, slot 1. Injury episode: admitted in Round 1, due at the end of Round 2.
Room A slot 3 is empty; nobody else changed slot.
Blue Disabler: the Blackout use is spent; the Main Action of that turn is used.
visibility: Until X the public view, the shared display and every seat but the Blue Disabler read exactly what they read in BLK-01 at the same moments.
The request, its admission, the selection and its receipt are in the Blue Disabler's private view only.
After X: Undercover's health and place are public, with no cause, source, direction or room of origin.
timing: Result [V, V + 5 s). Window from W ≥ V + 5 s: lit [W, W + 5 s), dark [W + 5 s, W + 15 s). The round resolves at X ≥ W + 15 s.
The same instants as BLK-01, whenever the selection is made.

cases.title: Selecting at the first instant of darkness shortens nothing
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: The Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3 at W + 5 s exactly.

state: The selection is accepted and final.
The outcome is that of BLK-02.
visibility: Nothing public changes at the moment of selection: no phase change, no lighting change, no revision of anyone else's view.
timing: Accepted at W + 5 s, the first instant of the dark interval.
The window still ends at W + 15 s and the round does not resolve before it.

cases.title: A selection sent in the lit preview is refused and locks nothing
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: The Blue Disabler sends Room A slot 3 at W + 2 s.
The Blue Disabler sends Room A slot 3 again at W + 7 s.

state: The first is refused: nothing is spent and no selection is locked.
The second is accepted and final. The outcome is that of BLK-02; the use is spent once.
visibility: The refusal is the sender's own receipt and nobody else's.
timing: Selections are accepted only in [W + 5 s, W + 15 s).

cases.title: A selection at the instant the window ends is too late
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: The Blue Disabler sends Room A slot 3 at W + 15 s exactly and nothing before.

state: Refused: the dark interval is half open.
The admitted request ends as a miss: no damage, no replacement target.
The Blackout use is spent.
visibility: No public trace of the miss.
timing: The last accepted instant is the last server instant before W + 15 s.

cases.title: The first valid selection is final
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: Slot 3 at W + 6 s.
Slot 1 at W + 8 s, as a new command.
The first command again, with its own command identifier, at W + 9 s.

state: Slot 3 is accepted.
Slot 1 is refused and replaces nothing.
The repeat returns the receipt of the first command and changes nothing.
One attack, on the frozen occupant of slot 3; the use is spent once.
visibility: Only the Blue Disabler reads any of the three answers.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Inputs that are wrong lock nothing, and the deadline still applies
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: In darkness the Blue Disabler sends, one after another: a slot of Room B; a slot of Jail; a slot of Hospital; slot 6 of Room A; a selection that names an earlier snapshot.
Nothing else is sent before W + 15 s.

state: Each is refused. None locks a selection and none spends the use at that moment.
At the deadline the request ends as a miss and the use is spent once.
Nobody is hurt.
visibility: No public trace.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: No selection at all, with the phone offline through the window
preconditions: As BLK-02, and the Blue Disabler's phone loses its connection before W.
sequence: The window runs to its end without a selection.

state: A miss: no damage, no random target, no retry in a later round.
The Blackout use is spent.
visibility: No public trace. The Blue Disabler reads the spent use on reconnecting.
timing: The window is not paused or extended for the missing phone.

cases.title: An empty position, also when its occupant left before the window
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout.
During a later turn the Alien moves to Room B and takes slot 4 there. Room A slot 4 is now empty.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 4.

state: A miss: accepted, final, no damage.
The Alien, in Room B, is not hurt: a Blackout has no named target and no replacement.
The Blackout use is spent.
visibility: The empty position is offered like every other position. No public trace of the miss.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The Disabler's own position
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 2, their own.
Then sends slot 3.

state: Slot 2 is accepted and final: a miss, no damage to the Blue Disabler or to anyone.
Slot 3 is refused: there is no second try.
The Blackout use is spent.
visibility: The own position is neutral and selectable in darkness, with no warning, label or highlight.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A position held by a player Eliminated in an earlier round
preconditions: Layout ARMS. The election after Round 1 elects the Alien. Round 3: the Alien moves out to Room A and takes slot 5; Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler. Round 4: the Cracker and Undercover each register a shot at the Alien in Room A, and the Alien then moves into Command Room. The Alien is Eliminated, and the body is seated in Room A slot 5 (HSP-20).
sequence: Round 5. Blue Disabler, own turn, in Room A, with the Blackout unspent: requests a Blackout.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 5, where the Alien's body lies.

state: The selection is the miss of a position held by a player who was already Eliminated when the snapshot was taken: no further effect, no replacement target.
The Blackout use is spent.
visibility: No public trace of the miss. The lit preview shows the body in slot 5.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If the transfer to Hospital at the first hit is taken to decide where this body lies too (HSP-20, NV-F-01), slot 5 is empty and this is the miss of an empty position, as in BLK-09.

cases.title: Jailed before the window: the request is cancelled and the use is kept
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout.
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Blue Disabler. It closes at V.
Result, window, resolution.

state: Blue Disabler: Jailed at V, in Jail slot 1. Room A slot 2 is empty.
The request is cancelled before admission. No attack exists and nobody is hurt.
The Blackout use is NOT spent.
The request does not come back in a later round by itself.
visibility: Public: the tally, and the Blue Disabler in Jail.
From V on, the public view, the shared display and every other seat read what they read in a run in which the jailed player had asked for nothing.
The Blue Disabler gets no selection control, and reads privately that the use is still theirs.
There is no public sign of a cancellation.
timing: Result [V, V + 5 s). Window from W ≥ V + 5 s: lit [W, W + 5 s), dark [W + 5 s, W + 15 s). The round resolves at X ≥ W + 15 s.

cases.title: The kept use, used in a later round after a RELEASE
preconditions: The end of BLK-12. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn: RELEASE.
Blue Disabler, own turn, later in the same round: requests a Blackout.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3.

state: The release puts the Blue Disabler in Room A slot 2, the lowest free slot of the room they remember.
The request is accepted: the player is Healthy and free on their own turn and the use is unspent.
Undercover: Injured, Hospital slot 1, admitted in Round 2, due at the end of Round 3.
The Blackout use is spent now.
visibility: The release is public. The request and the selection are private.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A cancelled Disabler's ordinary shot of the same round still resolves
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Blue Disabler and the Alien.
sequence: Round 4. Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout and registers a shot at Undercover (Room A slot 4).
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Blue Disabler.

state: The Blackout request is cancelled; its use is kept.
The shot resolves although its shooter is now in Jail: Undercover is Injured, Hospital slot 1, admitted in Round 4, due at the end of Round 5.
The weapon is spent.
visibility: Undercover's injury is public, without a cause.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The request follows the Disabler to the room they are in when the window opens
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn (third): requests a Blackout in Room A.
During the Hacker's turn the Blue Disabler moves to Room B and takes slot 4.
In darkness the Blue Disabler sends Room A slot 3, then Room B slot 1.

state: The request is bound to Room B. The map is Room B's as frozen at W.
Room A slot 3 is refused as a wrong room and locks nothing.
Room B slot 1 is accepted: the Insider is Injured, Hospital slot 1.
Nobody in Room A is hurt.
visibility: The move is public when it is made. Nothing ties it to a request.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The snapshot is taken after the vote has placed its prisoner
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout.
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name Undercover.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3.

state: At V Undercover is in Jail slot 1 and Room A slot 3 is empty.
The frozen map of Room A has no occupant in slot 3: a miss.
Undercover is not hurt. The Blackout use is spent.
The vote is not affected by anything in the window.
visibility: The lit preview shows Room A without Undercover.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Disabler who is Captain and has stepped into Command Room when the window opens
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Blue Disabler. In Round 2 the Blue Disabler moves out to Room A and takes slot 2.
sequence: Round 3. Blue Disabler, own turn, in Room A: requests a Blackout.
Later in Round 3 the Blue Disabler moves into Command Room.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects the one position of Command Room, or selects nothing.

state: The request is admitted: the player is Healthy and free.
It is bound to the room the Disabler is in when the window opens: Command Room, whose one position is the Disabler's own.
Either way it is a miss, and the Blackout use is spent.
visibility: No public trace.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Two Disablers in two rooms
preconditions: Layout SPLIT. Round 1.
sequence: Both Disablers request on their own turns.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3 (Undercover) and the Red Disabler selects Room B slot 1 (Insider).

state: Each request is bound to its own room and its own frozen map.
Undercover and the Insider are Injured.
Both are in Hospital, in positions 1 and 2.
Both uses are spent.
visibility: One window, the same for everyone. Nothing shows how many requests there were.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

notes: Which of the two holds position 1 is the question of SLOT-03 (NV-F-03). The attack on Undercover resolves first.

cases.title: Both Disablers choose the same occupied position
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: Cracker, own turn: registers a Rescue of Undercover, who is Healthy and in the same room.
Both Disablers request on their own turns.
In darkness both select Room A slot 3.

state: Two attack records are kept and resolved one after the other in turn order.
Undercover: Healthy, then Injured, then Eliminated, all in the attack stage.
The Rescue stage finds Undercover Eliminated: no effect. The Cracker has one Rescue left.
Both Blackout uses are spent.
By the letter of the packet the body is in Hospital, where the first hit had put the player (NV-F-01).
visibility: Public: Undercover Eliminated. Two hits are shown as two outcomes, not merged into one.
Undercover's faction is shown at the end-of-round reveal.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If a player eliminated in the stage that first hurt them keeps their position (NV-F-01), the body lies in Room A slot 3.

cases.title: The same position, and its occupant holds an active Protection
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. It is active from Round 2.
sequence: Round 2. Both Disablers request on their own turns.
In darkness both select Room A slot 1 (Cracker).

state: The first attack in turn order is blocked and uses up the Protection.
The second injures: the Cracker is in Hospital slot 1, admitted in Round 2, due at the end of Round 3.
Both uses are spent.
visibility: The block is a room event for the seats of Room A (DEF-01). The injury is public.
Undercover reads privately that the Protection was used up.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The same position, and its occupant is the Alien under an active Clone
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Alien. It is active from Round 2.
sequence: Round 2. The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone.
Both Disablers request on their own turns.
In darkness both select Room A slot 4 (Alien).

state: Both attacks are blocked by the Clone.
The Clone stays active until Round 3 has resolved.
The Protection is not used up and stays active.
The Alien is Healthy in Room A slot 4. Both uses are spent.
visibility: Two block events on the Alien, each to the seats of Room A, each the same as a Protection block.
Undercover's private record still shows the Protection unused.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: One Disabler picks their own position and the other picks the same position
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Both Disablers request on their own turns.
sequence: In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 2, their own. The Red Disabler selects Room A slot 2 as well.

state: The Blue Disabler's selection is a miss for the Blue Disabler only.
The Red Disabler's attack stands: the Blue Disabler is Injured, Hospital slot 1.
Both uses are spent.
visibility: The injury is public, without a cause.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The two Disablers hit each other
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Both Disablers request on their own turns.
sequence: In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 5 (Red Disabler) and the Red Disabler selects Room A slot 2 (Blue Disabler).

state: Both attempts are registered before either resolves.
The Blue Disabler's attack resolves first and injures the Red Disabler.
The Red Disabler's attack still resolves, although its actor is now Injured, and injures the Blue Disabler.
Both are in Hospital, in positions 1 and 2.
visibility: Both injuries are public, without causes, in an order that does not follow the attackers.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

notes: Which of the two holds position 1 is the question of SLOT-03 (NV-F-03). The attack on the Red Disabler resolves first.

cases.title: A Blackout and an ordinary shot on one player, and a Rescue registered for them
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4.
sequence: Cracker, own turn (second): registers a Rescue of the Alien, who is Healthy and in the same room.
Blue Disabler, own turn (third): requests a Blackout.
Undercover, own turn (fifth): registers a shot at the Alien with their own weapon.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 4 (Alien).

state: Attack stage, in turn order, Main Action before Shot: the Blackout injures the Alien; Undercover's shot eliminates the Alien.
Rescue stage: the Alien is Eliminated; the Rescue has no effect and is spent.
The Blackout use and the weapon are spent.
By the letter of the packet the body is in Hospital, where the first hit had put the player (NV-F-01).
visibility: Public: the Alien Eliminated, two outcomes. The faction is shown at the end-of-round reveal.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If a player eliminated in the stage that first hurt them keeps their position (NV-F-01), the body lies in Room A slot 4.

cases.title: A third attack on a player who was Eliminated earlier in the same stage
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Blue Disabler and the Alien.
sequence: Round 4. Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout and registers a shot at the Cracker (Room A slot 1).
Undercover, own turn: registers a shot at the Cracker.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 1.

state: Player 3's Main Action injures the Cracker; player 3's Shot eliminates the Cracker.
Player 5's Shot has no effect. Its target is not changed and its weapon is spent.
visibility: Public: the Cracker Eliminated. Nothing shows a third attempt.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The order in which two selections arrive decides nothing
preconditions: As BLK-20, played twice.
sequence: Run one: the Red Disabler's selection reaches the server before the Blue Disabler's.
Run two: after it.

state: The final state is the same in both runs.
The attacks resolve in the stored turn order in both.
visibility: Every audience reads the same payloads in both runs, in the same order.
timing: The times of the public and room outcomes do not follow the arrival of either selection.

cases.title: Reconnecting in darkness
preconditions: As BLK-02. The Blue Disabler's phone drops at W + 3 s and returns at W + 9 s.
sequence: On return the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3 at W + 11 s.

state: Accepted: the request was admitted at W and the dark interval is still open.
The outcome is that of BLK-02.
visibility: On return the phone shows darkness and the remaining time. The lit preview is not replayed.
timing: The remaining time is W + 15 s minus the server's now, not a fresh ten seconds.

cases.title: An accepted selection whose acknowledgement never arrives
preconditions: As BLK-02. The selection of slot 3 is accepted at W + 8 s and its acknowledgement is lost.
sequence: The phone sends nothing more, or repeats the same command after W + 15 s.

state: The accepted selection stands and takes precedence over the timeout: Undercover is Injured.
A repeat with the same identifier returns the original receipt, also after the window.
visibility: Private to the Blue Disabler.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Nobody can select for a Disabler, and nobody without an admitted request can select
preconditions: As BLK-02.
sequence: In darkness the Cracker sends Room A slot 3.
The Red Disabler, who made no request, sends Room A slot 3.

state: Refused. Nothing is spent and nothing is locked.
The Red Disabler's use is untouched.
The Blue Disabler's own selection is unaffected.
visibility: The refusal is the sender's own receipt.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: One Blackout in a match, hit or miss
preconditions: After BLK-02, or after any of the misses BLK-05, BLK-09, BLK-10.
sequence: In a later round the Blue Disabler, Healthy and free, requests a Blackout on their own turn.

state: Refused. The Main Action of that turn is not used by the refusal.
visibility: The Blue Disabler's private view shows the use as spent from the round it was spent in.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: When a request can be made
preconditions: Layout ARMS. The Blue Disabler holds an unspent use, and in Round 4 a weapon from Supplier.
sequence: A request on another player's turn; in a Hack stage; in the vote, its result or the window.
A request while Injured; a request while Jailed.
Round 4, own turn, Healthy and free: a request, a shot at Undercover and a Hack request to the Cracker.

state: The first five are refused and spend nothing.
The last three are all accepted: the request uses the Main Action and leaves Shot and Hack alone.
visibility: The request has no public cue.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Blackout in Round 5
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 5. The Blue Disabler's use is unspent.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn: requests a Blackout. In darkness selects Room A slot 3 (Undercover).

state: Undercover is Injured when Round 5 resolves, in Hospital.
No Hospital death is due for this new injury and no round is added.
At the Round 5 check Undercover counts nothing for Red Power.
If there is no winner, the showdown follows and Undercover takes part from Hospital.
visibility: As BLK-02.
timing: Result [V, V + 5 s). Window from W ≥ V + 5 s: lit [W, W + 5 s), dark [W + 5 s, W + 15 s). The round resolves at X ≥ W + 15 s.
The window runs in Round 5 as in every round.

cases.title: An attack whose actor is Eliminated earlier in the same stage still resolves
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler.
sequence: Round 4. Cracker, own turn (second): registers a shot at Undercover (Room A slot 4).
Blue Disabler, own turn (third): requests a Blackout.
Undercover, own turn (fifth): registers a shot at the Alien with their own weapon.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 4 (Undercover).

state: In turn order: the Cracker's shot injures Undercover; the Blackout eliminates Undercover.
Undercover's shot, registered while Undercover was alive, still resolves: the Alien is Injured, in Hospital, admitted in Round 4 and due at the end of Round 5.
Both weapons and the Blackout use are spent.
By the letter of the packet the body is in Hospital, where the first hit had put the player (NV-F-01).
visibility: Public: Undercover Eliminated and the Alien Injured, with no cause. Nothing shows that the Alien was hit by a player who was already dead.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If a player eliminated in the stage that first hurt them keeps their position (NV-F-01), Undercover's body lies in Room A slot 4.

cases.title: A Blackout on an occupant who was alive at the snapshot and is Eliminated earlier in the stage
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Alien.
Round 4: the turn order is by player number, except that the Blue Disabler is last.
sequence: Round 4. The Cracker and the Alien each register a shot at Undercover (Room A slot 4) on their own turns.
Blue Disabler, own turn (last): requests a Blackout.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 4. Undercover is alive in the snapshot.

state: In turn order: the Cracker's shot injures Undercover; the Alien's shot eliminates Undercover.
The Blackout, last, has no further effect and takes no other target.
The Blackout use is spent, and both weapons.
visibility: Public: Undercover Eliminated, two outcomes. Nothing shows a third attempt.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Protection takes the first of two attacks, and the second injures
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. It is active from Round 2.
sequence: Round 4. Blue Disabler, own turn (third): requests a Blackout. Undercover, own turn (fifth): registers a shot at the Cracker.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 1 (Cracker).

state: The Blackout is applied first and is blocked; the Protection is used up.
The shot injures: the Cracker is in Hospital, admitted in Round 4, due at the end of Round 5.
The Blackout use and the weapon are spent.
visibility: The block is a room event for the seats of Room A. The injury is public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: One request cancelled by the vote and one admitted, in the same window
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Both Disablers request on their own turns.
sequence: Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Red Disabler.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3 (Undercover).

state: At V the Red Disabler is in Jail slot 1. Their request is cancelled and their use is kept.
The Blue Disabler's request is admitted: Undercover is Injured, in Hospital slot 1. That use is spent.
visibility: One window, the same for everyone as in BLK-01. Nothing shows that there were two requests, or that one was cancelled.
timing: Result [V, V + 5 s). Window from W ≥ V + 5 s: lit [W, W + 5 s), dark [W + 5 s, W + 15 s). The round resolves at X ≥ W + 15 s.

cases.title: A requester who is no longer Healthy when the window opens
preconditions: A constructed state: at W a Disabler has a request of this round pending and is Injured.
sequence: The window opens.

state: The request is cancelled before admission. The use is kept, and there is no public sign.
By legal play this state does not arise: nothing deals damage between a request and the window of the same round. Only the vote of the round makes a requester ineligible (BLK-12).
visibility: Not applicable.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A move during another player's turn, before the mover's own
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1, the Insider's turn (first).
sequence: The Alien moves to Room B.

state: Accepted and applied at once.
The Alien is in Room B slot 4, the lowest free slot.
Room A slot 4 is empty. Nobody else changes slot.
The Alien's move of Round 1 is used; the room they remember is Room B.
visibility: Public at once.
timing: At any server instant of the turn stage.

cases.title: A move after the mover's own turn
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1, Undercover's turn (fifth). The Cracker's turn (second) is over.
sequence: The Cracker moves to Room B.

state: Accepted.
The Cracker is in Room B slot 4; Room A slot 1 is empty.
visibility: Public at once.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Moves during a Hack that is not the round's last, one in each stage
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. The Insider (first) requests a Hack with the Supplier on their own turn.
sequence: Declaration stage: the Cracker moves to Room B.
Result stage: the Hacker moves to Room A.
Conversation stage: the Alien moves to Room B.

state: All three are accepted.
Cracker: Room B slot 4. Hacker: Room A slot 1, the hole the Cracker left. Alien: Room B slot 3, the hole the Hacker left.
Nobody who did not move changes slot.
visibility: Each move is public when made.
timing: The Hack's three deadlines are not changed by the moves.

cases.title: The final ordinary turn ends: voluntary movement is closed
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Nobody has moved.
The last turn is the Red Disabler's. It ends at its deadline with no Hack requested.
sequence: The Supplier sends a move during the Jail vote.
The Insider sends a move during the result.
The Hacker sends a move in the lit preview, and again in darkness.

state: Each is refused. No move is marked as used.
No player is offered a destination from the end of the final turn until the round has resolved. What holds after that, during an election, is MOV-14.
visibility: The refusals are the senders' own receipts.
timing: Movement closes when the final ordinary turn ends: at its deadline on the server's clock, or at an accepted Pass. A closure that commits late keeps nothing open (MOV-15).

cases.title: The final player's Hack does not reopen movement
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Nobody has moved.
The Red Disabler, on the last turn, requests a Hack with a player of their room.
sequence: After that turn ends the Insider sends a move in the declaration stage, the Supplier in the result stage and the Hacker in the conversation stage.
One of the two Hack participants sends a move in the conversation stage.

state: All are refused. Nobody's move is used.
visibility: The refusals are private.
timing: Movement closed when the final ordinary turn ended, before the declaration stage opened.

cases.title: The final turn is ended by Pass
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Nobody has moved.
sequence: The Red Disabler, on the last turn, passes ten seconds into it.
One second later the Insider sends a move.

state: The pass closes the turn and, with it, voluntary movement.
The Insider's move is refused, although the sixty seconds of the turn would not have been over.
visibility: The pass is public as the phase change it causes.
timing: The Jail vote opens at the pass with its full sixty seconds.

cases.title: One voluntary move in a round, and a forced transfer is not one
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. The election elects the Insider.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn (first): RELEASE.
Undercover then moves to Room B, and afterwards sends a move back to Room A.

state: The release places Undercover in Room A slot 3 and uses no move.
The move to Room B is accepted: slot 1, the lowest free slot.
The move back is refused: one voluntary move in a round.
visibility: Release and move are public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Transfers the game makes after the cutoff still happen
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. The Blue Disabler has requested a Blackout.
sequence: After the final turn: the Jail vote (4 of 8) jails the Supplier.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 3 (Undercover).

state: At V the Supplier is in Jail slot 1.
At X Undercover is in Hospital slot 1.
Neither transfer is a move, and neither is held back because voluntary movement is closed.
visibility: Both transfers are public when they happen.
timing: Jail placement at V, before the window. Hospital admission at X.

cases.title: Which turn is the final one when the last seat of the order is Eliminated
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures the Alien (Room A slot 4). Nobody rescues; the Alien dies at the end of Round 2.
Round 3: the turn order is by player number, except that the Alien is last. The last living seat of the order is the Red Disabler.
sequence: Round 3. The Red Disabler's turn ends.
The Insider sends a move.

state: The Alien takes no turn.
Voluntary movement closed with the last living seat's turn: the Insider's move is refused.
The Jail vote opens next.
visibility: Public: the phase goes from that turn to the Jail vote.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: An EJECT removes the player who would have had the last turn
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the vote jails the Red Disabler. The election elects the Insider.
Round 2: the turn order is by player number, except that the Insider is second to last and the Red Disabler is last.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn: EJECT.
Still in the Insider's turn the Cracker moves to Room B.
The Insider's turn ends. The Supplier sends a move.

state: The Red Disabler is Eliminated and takes no turn.
The Insider's turn has become the final ordinary turn. The Cracker's move, made inside it, is accepted.
The Supplier's move is refused.
The Jail vote that follows has 7 eligible voters; 4 ballots for one player jail.
visibility: Public: the EJECT, the Cracker's move, the vote's eligible voters.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Nobody walks out of Hospital or Jail
preconditions: A patient in Hospital; a prisoner in Jail; a detained patient in Hospital (as HSP-02).
sequence: Each sends a move to Room A during the turn stage.

state: Each is refused. None is offered a destination.
visibility: Private refusals.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The Captain leaves Command Room and cannot return in the same round
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is in Command Room slot 1. Room B slot 1 is empty.
sequence: Round 2, during another player's turn: the Insider moves to Room B.
Later in Round 2 the Insider sends a move to Command Room.
Round 3: the Insider moves to Command Room.

state: Accepted: Room B slot 1. Command Room is empty. The Insider stays Captain.
Refused: the round's move is used.
Accepted: Command Room slot 1.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A room of five takes nobody
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
Room A holds five.
sequence: The Insider sends a move to Room A.

state: Refused. The move is not used.
Room A is not among the destinations offered to anyone while it holds five.
visibility: Private refusal.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A move while a Captain election is being held
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1 has resolved. The election of the first Captain is open.
sequence: The Cracker sends a move to Room B.

state: Recommended reading (NV-F-05): refused. The move belongs to the player-turn stage, which opens with the round's first ordinary turn.
The Cracker's move of Round 2 is unused.
visibility: Private refusal.
timing: The window for voluntary movement runs from the opening of the round's first ordinary turn to the end of its final one.

otherOutcome: Accepted, as the engines of today do, and charged to Round 2.

cases.title: A move sent after the final turn's deadline, while its closure is late
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. Nobody has moved. The last turn's deadline is T.
sequence: The closure of the last turn is delivered two seconds late and commits at T + 2 s.
The Insider sends a move at T + 1 s.

state: Refused: the turn was over at T on the server's clock, and with it voluntary movement. The Insider's move is unused.
The Jail vote opens at T + 2 s with its full sixty seconds.
visibility: A private refusal.
timing: Input is accepted until a deadline, whatever the moment at which the closure commits.

cases.title: A RELEASE on the round's final turn: the released may move until that turn ends
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. The election elects the Insider.
Round 2: the turn order is by player number, except that the Insider is last.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn (last): RELEASE.
Still in the Insider's turn, Undercover moves to Room B.
The Insider's turn ends. The Alien sends a move.

state: The release places Undercover in Room A slot 3.
Undercover's move is accepted: Room B slot 1. The turn in which Undercover could have acted is past; the move of the round is not.
The Alien's move is refused.
visibility: Public: the release and Undercover's move.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: How many positions there are, and who holds which at the start
preconditions: Layout MIX, before anything is done.
sequence: The match opens.

state: Room A 5 positions, Room B 5, Jail 5, Command Room 1, Hospital 8. The numbers do not change during the match.
Every position exists from the start, the empty ones too.
The players of a starting room hold its lowest positions in order of player number. This order is a reading (NV-F-06): the packet gives none.
visibility: Positions are public: the board shows who stands where.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: Any other fixed order. The counts of positions do not depend on it.

cases.title: One occupant a position, one position a player, in every published state
preconditions: Any match.
sequence: Any state that any audience can read, at any moment.

state: No position has two occupants.
Every player who is on the board has exactly one position, with a number within its room's count.
A player removed by EJECT has none.
No Injured player is shown anywhere but in Hospital.
visibility: The same positions for every audience.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Two players hurt in one round take Hospital positions by player number, not in the order the attacks resolved
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4.
sequence: Blue Disabler, own turn (third): requests a Blackout.
Undercover, own turn (fifth): registers a shot at the Blue Disabler.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 4 (Alien).

state: The Blackout resolves first and injures the Alien; then the shot injures the Blue Disabler.
Recommended reading (NV-F-03): positions are given when the stage is complete, in order of player number. Hospital: Blue Disabler (player 3) slot 1, Alien (player 7) slot 2.
visibility: Under the recommended reading the two positions tell the table nothing about which attack came first.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: In the order of the hits: the Alien in slot 1 and the Blue Disabler in slot 2.

cases.title: A hole is taken by the next player who enters, and a former occupant has no claim on it
preconditions: Layout MIX.
sequence: Round 1: the Alien moves to Room B. Then the Hacker moves to Room A.
Round 2: the Alien sends a move to Room A.

state: The Hacker takes Room A slot 4, the hole the Alien left.
Round 2: refused; Room A holds five again.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Jail positions over a match
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider.
sequence: Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. Round 2: the vote jails the Supplier.
Round 3: Insider, own turn: RELEASE. Round 3: the vote jails the Hacker.

state: Undercover: Jail slot 1. Supplier: Jail slot 2.
After the release Jail is empty.
The Hacker takes Jail slot 1.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A body keeps its Hospital position
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures Undercover (Hospital slot 1). Nobody rescues, and Undercover dies at the end of Round 2.
Round 3: Supplier arms the Insider and the Hacker.
sequence: Round 4. The Hacker moves to Room A, takes slot 3 there, and registers a shot at the Alien.

state: Undercover's body is in Hospital slot 1 from the end of Round 2 on.
The Alien is Injured when Round 4 resolves and takes Hospital slot 2, the lowest free position.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Activation
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2. The Alien is Healthy and free.
sequence: The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone.

state: Accepted and in effect at once.
The Clone is active and is scheduled to end when Round 3 has resolved.
The one use of the match is spent; the Main Action of that turn is used.
Health, room, position and Power are unchanged.
visibility: The Alien's private view only.
The public view, the shared display and every other seat read exactly what they read in a run in which the Alien did nothing on that turn, at every moment until an attack on the Alien is blocked.
No asset, sound or timing that anyone else can observe differs.
timing: At the server instant of acceptance.

cases.title: Activations that are refused
preconditions: Layout MIX. The Clone is unused unless the line says otherwise.
sequence: On another player's turn; in a Hack stage; in the vote, its result or the window.
On the Alien's own turn while Injured; while Jailed.
A second time, in a later round, after it was used.
By a seat that is not the Alien.

state: Each is refused. Nothing is spent and nothing changes.
visibility: Private refusals. No refusal differs by role in a way another seat could read.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Shot and Hack stay available on the turn of activation
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Alien and the Cracker.
sequence: Round 4. The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone, registers a shot at Undercover and requests a Hack with the Cracker.

state: All three are accepted.
visibility: Only the Hack becomes public, when its first stage opens.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: From activation to the end of the following round, and not beyond
preconditions: Layout ARMS (Alien in Room A slot 5). Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler.
sequence: Round 3. The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone. The Blue Disabler requests a Blackout and in darkness selects Room A slot 5.
Round 4. Undercover registers a shot at the Alien.
Round 5. The Cracker registers a shot at the Alien.

state: Round 3: blocked.
Round 4: blocked. The Clone ends when Round 4 has resolved.
Round 5: not blocked. The Alien is Injured, in Hospital; no death is due.
The Blackout use and both weapons are spent.
visibility: Two room events in Rounds 3 and 4; a public injury in Round 5.
timing: Active from acceptance in Round 3 until the end-of-round checkpoint of Round 4.

cases.title: An activation late in the round covers attacks registered earlier in it
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4. Undercover's turn (fifth) is before the Alien's (seventh).
sequence: Undercover registers a shot at the Alien.
The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone.

state: The shot is blocked: defences are read when the attack resolves.
The weapon is spent.
visibility: A room event.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Several attacks in one round
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler.
sequence: Round 4. The Alien activates the Clone.
The Blue Disabler requests a Blackout and registers a shot at the Alien; the Cracker and Undercover each register a shot at the Alien.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 5.

state: All four attacks are blocked.
The Clone is still active; it ends when Round 5 has resolved.
The Alien is Healthy.
visibility: Four room events, each the same.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Clone first, the Protection kept, the Protection used afterwards
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 2: Undercover grants Protection to the Alien (active from Round 3). Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler.
sequence: Round 3. The Alien activates the Clone.
Round 4. The Cracker registers a shot at the Alien.
Round 5. The Blue Disabler registers a shot at the Alien.

state: Round 4: blocked by the Clone. The Protection is not used up.
The Clone ends when Round 4 has resolved.
Round 5: blocked by the Protection, which is used up.
The Alien is Healthy throughout.
visibility: Undercover's private record: unused after Round 4, used after Round 5.
The two room events are the same.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Jailed after activation
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who stays in Command Room. Round 4.
sequence: Undercover registers a shot at the Alien. The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone.
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Alien.
Round 5: the Insider, own turn (first), uses RELEASE; the Alien, own turn, then tries to activate again.

state: At V the Alien is in Jail.
The shot resolves there and is blocked: the Clone is still active.
Its end is unchanged: when Round 5 has resolved.
The second activation is refused: the use is spent.
visibility: The block is a room event for the seats in Jail at that moment, the Alien among them. Room A, the shooter included, gets nothing.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: EJECT takes no notice of the Clone
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2: the Alien activates the Clone; the vote jails the Alien. A Captain is in office.
sequence: Round 3. The Captain, own turn, in Command Room: EJECT.

state: The Alien is Eliminated. The Clone ends with them.
There is no block.
visibility: No room event. The elimination is public; the faction is shown at the end-of-round reveal.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Activation in Round 5
preconditions: Layout MIX. Nobody was hurt in Rounds 1 to 4. The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jailed the Insider and the Supplier. The election before Round 2 elected the Hacker, who is in Command Room. Neither command was used. No Code was submitted.
Undercover has kept their weapon.
sequence: Round 5. The Alien activates the Clone. Undercover registers a shot at the Alien.
Round 5 resolves: Power is 3 and 3, no winner. In the showdown Undercover names the Alien.

state: The Round 5 shot is blocked.
The Clone ends when the normal resolution of Round 5 is complete, before the showdown.
The special shot is not blocked: the Alien is Injured, in Hospital.
visibility: One room event, in Round 5.
timing: No Clone is active at any moment of the showdown.

cases.title: Activated in Round 4, then the showdown, with a Protection in reserve
preconditions: Layout MIX. Nobody was hurt in Rounds 1 to 4. The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jailed the Insider and the Supplier. The election before Round 2 elected the Hacker, who is in Command Room. Neither command was used. No Code was submitted.
Round 3: Undercover grants Protection to the Alien (active from Round 4).
sequence: Round 4. The Alien activates the Clone. Undercover registers a shot at the Alien.
Round 5 resolves: Power is 3 and 3, no winner. In the showdown Undercover and the Blue Disabler name the Alien.

state: Round 4: blocked by the Clone; the Protection is kept.
Showdown: the first special shot in the Round 5 order is blocked by the Protection, which is used up. The second injures the Alien.
visibility: The showdown block is a room event for the seats of the Alien's room.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: What the Clone does not stop
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2: the Alien activates the Clone. It is active until Round 3 has resolved.
sequence: Round 3. Cracker, own turn: registers a Rescue of the Alien. Undercover, own turn: requests a Hack with the Alien, and it runs.
The Alien then moves to Room B. Hacker, own turn: scans the Alien there.
The Jail vote (4 of 8) names the Alien.

state: The Hack runs through its three stages.
The Scan returns its result at once, as for any target.
The Alien is jailed at the closing of the vote.
The Rescue finds a Healthy target, heals nobody and is spent.
None of the four is blocked.
visibility: No room event.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Injury while the Clone is active
preconditions: A constructed state: the Alien is Injured in Hospital and the Clone is active.
sequence: The round in which the injury episode is due resolves.

state: The injury did not end the Clone and the Clone does not stop the Hospital death.
By legal play this state does not arise: activation needs a Healthy Alien, and while the Clone is active every source of damage in a normal round is blocked.
visibility: Not applicable.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The end of the Clone
preconditions: The Clone was activated in Round 2 and nothing attacked the Alien.
sequence: Round 3 resolves.

state: The Clone is inactive from the end-of-round checkpoint of Round 3, before the victory check of that round is read by anyone.
Health, room, position and Power are unchanged by the end.
visibility: A private notice to the Alien. Nothing else: the public figure is the same before and after.
timing: After the attack, Rescue and Hospital stages of the round and its reveals; with the victory check.

cases.title: Activation by an Alien who is Captain, inside Command Room
preconditions: The Alien is Captain and in Command Room. Round 2.
sequence: The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone.

state: Recommended reading (NV-F-10): accepted. The activation names nobody, and the packet's conditions for it are the Alien's own turn, Healthy and not Jailed.
visibility: Private.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: Refused, if the rule that a Captain inside Command Room cannot protect themself (R-CAPT-15) is read to cover the Clone.

cases.title: An activation that is delivered twice, or sent again in a later round
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2.
sequence: The Alien, own turn: activates the Clone. The same command is delivered a second time in Round 2.
In Round 3 the same command, with its own identifier, is delivered again.
In Round 4 the Alien sends a new activation.

state: One activation. Each repeat returns the receipt of the first and changes nothing.
The end stays where it was: when Round 3 has resolved. Nothing restarts or extends it.
The new activation of Round 4 is refused: the use is spent.
visibility: Private to the Alien.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: RELEASE
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover (Jail slot 1). Round 2: the vote jails the Supplier (Jail slot 2).
sequence: Round 3. Insider, own turn: RELEASE.

state: Accepted, in effect at once. There is no vote and no choice of prisoner.
Both are free. Seated by player number: the Supplier (4) in Room B slot 1; then Undercover (5) in Room A slot 3.
Jail is empty.
The RELEASE allowance of the match is used. The EJECT allowance is untouched.
The Insider's Main Action, Shot, Hack request and move are untouched.
visibility: Public at once: who is free and where. The Captain is known, and so is who pressed.
timing: At the server instant of acceptance, inside the Captain's turn.

cases.title: EJECT
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. Round 2: the vote jails the Supplier.
sequence: Round 3. Insider, own turn (first): EJECT.
The round continues.

state: Accepted, in effect at once: Undercover and the Supplier are Eliminated.
All five Jail positions are empty. The two are off the board, in the elimination record.
The EJECT allowance of the match is used. The RELEASE allowance is untouched.
Their turns later in Round 3 are not taken. They do not vote and cannot be voted for.
The Jail vote of Round 3 has 6 eligible voters; 3 ballots for one player jail.
The match does not end at the EJECT: victory is read at the end-of-round checkpoint.
visibility: Public at once: both Eliminated, Jail empty.
Their factions are NOT shown until the end-of-round reveal of Round 3: the table votes without them. Then Red for Undercover and Blue for the Supplier.
Roles and the Code stay hidden until the match ends.
timing: At the server instant of acceptance. Reveal and victory at the checkpoint of Round 3.

cases.title: An empty Jail
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Nobody is in Jail. Both allowances are unused.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn: RELEASE, then EJECT.

state: Both are refused. Neither allowance is spent.
Each button is temporarily unavailable, not used.
visibility: No success scene. The Captain reads that the button cannot be used now, which is not the same as used.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The wrong moment, the wrong place, the wrong player
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. Both allowances are unused.
sequence: The Insider, in Command Room, on another player's turn; in a Hack stage; in the vote, its result or the window.
The Insider, on their own turn, after moving out of Command Room.
The Cracker, who is not Captain, on their own turn.

state: Every attempt is refused. No allowance is spent and nothing changes.
visibility: Private refusals.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Two allowances, each its own
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn: RELEASE. The vote of Round 2 jails the Supplier.
Round 3. Insider, own turn: RELEASE, then EJECT.

state: Round 2: Undercover is free, in Room A slot 3.
Round 3: RELEASE is refused, used. EJECT is accepted: the Supplier is Eliminated.
visibility: The two buttons show their states apart: RELEASE used from Round 2, EJECT used from Round 3.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The allowances outlive the Captain who spent them
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn: EJECT.
The vote of Round 2 (4 of 7) jails the Insider.
The election before Round 3 elects the Cracker.
Round 3. Cracker, own turn, in Command Room: EJECT, then RELEASE.

state: Undercover is Eliminated in Round 2.
The Insider loses the title at V and is in Jail slot 1.
The new Captain's EJECT is refused: the match's EJECT is used.
The new Captain's RELEASE is accepted: the Insider is free, in Room B slot 1.
visibility: The EJECT button is shown as used to the new Captain from the first moment.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Both buttons in one turn
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. Both allowances are unused.
sequence: Round 2, one match: RELEASE, then EJECT.
Round 2, another match from the same state: EJECT, then RELEASE.

state: First match: Undercover is free; EJECT finds no living prisoner in Jail, is refused and stays unused.
Second match: Undercover is Eliminated; RELEASE finds no living prisoner, is refused and stays unused.
visibility: The second button is temporarily unavailable, not used.
timing: The second command is judged against the state the first one left.

cases.title: A detained patient is outside both commands
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
The end of HSP-02: the Alien is Injured, in Hospital, detained. Nobody is in Jail.
sequence: Round 5. Insider, own turn: RELEASE, then EJECT.

state: Both are refused: no living prisoner is physically in Jail. Neither allowance is spent.
The Alien stays in Hospital, detained, with the same deadline.
visibility: The buttons are temporarily unavailable.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A patient is left where they are while a prisoner beside them is released
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.

Round 3: the vote jails the Supplier (Jail slot 1). Round 4: Undercover registers a shot at the Alien; the vote jails the Alien (Jail slot 2); the shot injures the Alien, who is in Hospital and detained.
sequence: Round 5. Insider, own turn: RELEASE.

state: The Supplier is free, in Room B. The Alien is not released: still detained, still in Hospital.
The RELEASE allowance is used.
If the Alien is healed in Round 5 they return to Jail; nothing can release them then.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: No defence stops a command
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker (active from Round 2). The vote of Round 1 jails the Cracker.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn: EJECT.

state: The Cracker is Eliminated. The Protection blocks nothing.
visibility: No room event. Undercover's private record does not show the Protection as used up by a block.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A released player is free for the rest of the round
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover.
sequence: Round 2. Insider, own turn (first): RELEASE.
Undercover, own turn (fifth): grants Protection to the Cracker. Later moves to Room B.
The Jail vote of Round 2 opens.

state: Undercover is in Room A slot 3 from the release.
The grant is accepted: Undercover is Healthy and free on their own turn.
The move is accepted: Room B slot 1.
Undercover can be voted for in the Jail vote of Round 2.
Undercover counts for Red Power from the release.
visibility: Public: the release, the move, the list of who can be voted for.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Victory waits for the end of the round
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
The votes of Rounds 1, 2 and 3 jail Undercover, the Hacker and the Red Disabler: every Red player is in Jail.
sequence: Round 4. Insider, own turn (first): EJECT.
The other turns, the vote, the result, the window and the resolution follow.

state: Every Red player is Eliminated during the turns. The match goes on.
Whatever was registered in the round still resolves.
At the end-of-round checkpoint: every Red player is Eliminated and a Blue player is Healthy. Blue wins. The Alien wins with Blue.
visibility: The result, the roles and the Code appear at the checkpoint and not before.
timing: Not at the EJECT. At the checkpoint of the same round.

cases.title: The Hacker is ejected in Round 5, after or before the Code
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the vote jails the Hacker. The election elects the Cracker, who stays in Command Room. Nobody is hurt in the match.
sequence: Round 5, one match: during the Insider's turn (first) the Hacker submits the correct Code. Cracker, own turn (second): EJECT.
Round 5, another match: Cracker, own turn: EJECT. Afterwards the Hacker sends a Code.

state: First match: the attempt stands. At the Round 5 check the Code is correct and a Red player is Healthy: Red wins.
Second match: the attempt is refused; nobody inherits it.
visibility: Nobody is told whether the Code was right before the match ends.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A repeated command, and two commands at once
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails Undercover.
sequence: Round 2. The same EJECT command is delivered twice.
In another match the same RELEASE command is delivered twice.
In a third two different EJECT commands are sent at the same moment.

state: A second delivery returns the first receipt and changes nothing.
One of the two new commands is accepted; the other sees the committed state and is refused.
The allowance is spent once in each match.
visibility: One command is shown, once.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Stepping into Command Room and commanding in the same turn; stepping out and not
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider. Round 1: the vote jails Undercover. In Round 2 the Insider moves out to Room B.
sequence: Round 3. Insider, own turn: moves into Command Room, then RELEASE.
The vote of Round 3 jails the Supplier.
Round 4. Insider, own turn: moves out to Room B, then EJECT.

state: Round 3: both accepted; Undercover is free.
Round 4: the EJECT is refused, because the Captain is not in Command Room. It stays unused.
visibility: Public: the moves and the release.
timing: A voluntary move during the mover's own turn is legal (NV-A-02).

cases.title: RELEASE when the room a prisoner remembers has one place left
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
Round 1: the vote jails the Supplier. Round 2: the vote jails the Hacker. Both remember Room B.
Round 3, with the Insider last in the turn order: the Cracker, the Blue Disabler, Undercover and the Alien move to Room B, which then holds four.
sequence: Round 3. Insider, own turn: RELEASE.

state: The Supplier (player 4) is seated first: Room B slot 5. Room B is full.
The Hacker (player 6) goes to the other room: Room A slot 1.
The Hacker now remembers Room A.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Both factions gone between two victory checks, one of them by an EJECT earlier in the round
preconditions: Round 5. Every Red player is a Healthy prisoner in Jail. Every Blue player who is not Eliminated is a patient admitted in Round 4. The Alien is Healthy, free, Captain and in Command Room.

One legal line to this state, from layout ARMS: the election after Round 1 elects the Alien. In Round 1 the Red Disabler's Blackout injures the Insider, who dies at the end of Round 2. The votes of Rounds 1, 2 and 3 jail the Hacker, the Red Disabler and Undercover. In Round 3 the Alien comes out to Room A, and Supplier arms the Cracker and the Alien. Round 4, Room A: the Blue Disabler's Blackout hits the Supplier; the Cracker shoots the Blue Disabler; the Alien shoots the Cracker. In Round 5 the Alien moves back into Command Room.
sequence: Round 5. The Alien, own turn, in Command Room: EJECT.
Round 5 resolves: nobody was rescued, and every patient dies.

state: Every Red player is Eliminated during the turns; every Blue player is Eliminated when the round resolves; the Alien is not Eliminated.

By the rule the packet keeps (R-WIN-08), "at the same time" means within one complete resolution stage. Red was gone before that stage began: nothing was simultaneous, and no condition is met at the Round 5 check.
The showdown follows with one participant and no shot. The match is a Draw.
visibility: The Draw appears when the showdown has resolved.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If the owner decides that everything since the previous victory check counts as one stage, the Alien wins alone at the Round 5 check. The packet does not say so and this matrix does not assume it.
notes: For comparison: if the Alien does not use the EJECT, every Blue player is Eliminated at the Round 5 check and a Red player is Healthy, though Jailed, and Red wins.

cases.title: A detained patient who is healed is in reach of the commands again
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
The end of HSP-10: Undercover was healed when Round 3 resolved and is in Jail slot 1, Healthy and detained.
sequence: Round 4, one match: Insider, own turn: EJECT.
Round 4, another match from the same state: Insider, own turn: RELEASE.

state: First match: Undercover is Eliminated, and Jail is empty.
Second match: Undercover is free, in Room A slot 3.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

notes: While Undercover was a patient neither command reached them (CAP-08).

cases.title: A prisoner killed by shots registered before the vote, and what EJECT clears
preconditions: Layout ARMS. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who stays in Command Room. Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler; the vote jails the Hacker (Jail slot 1).

Round 4: the Cracker and the Blue Disabler each register a shot at Undercover. The vote (4 of 8) jails Undercover, who is in Jail slot 2 at V. When the round resolves the two shots injure Undercover and then eliminate them.
sequence: Round 5, one match: Insider, own turn: EJECT.
Round 5, another match in which the Hacker was never jailed: Insider, own turn: EJECT, then RELEASE.

state: By the letter of the packet the first shot moved Undercover to Hospital, detained, and the second killed them there. Jail holds no body.
First match: accepted. The Hacker is Eliminated and Jail is empty.
Second match: Jail is empty. Both commands are refused, and neither allowance is spent.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If a player eliminated in the stage that first hurt them keeps their position (NV-F-01), Undercover's body lies in Jail, in the position Undercover held: slot 2 in the first match, slot 1 in the second. In the first match the EJECT clears both positions, the body with them. In the second Jail holds only a body, and both commands are still refused, because no living prisoner is there.
notes: By the letter EJECT never clears a body, and the packet's "including retained eliminated bodies" has no case (NV-F-09).

cases.title: One full round: hurt in Round 2, dead at the end of Round 3
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures Undercover (Hospital slot 1). Admitted in Round 2; due at the end of Round 3.
sequence: Round 3. Nobody registers a Rescue of Undercover.
Round 3 resolves.

state: Undercover is Injured, alive and in Hospital through all of Round 3: the turns, the vote, the result, the window, the attack stage and the Rescue stage.
After the Rescue stage the due death applies: Undercover is Eliminated, in Hospital slot 1.
The faction is shown at the reveal of Round 3.
visibility: Public: the patient, and from server state how long the rescue opportunity lasts, in rounds.
The death is public when the round resolves, with no cause other than the Hospital itself.
timing: Not before the Rescue stage of Round 3 has resolved. No client clock can bring it forward.

cases.title: A prisoner who is hurt goes to Hospital and stays detained
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4.
sequence: Undercover, own turn: registers a shot at the Alien (Room A slot 4).
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Alien.
The round resolves.

state: At V the Alien is Jailed and in Jail slot 1.
At X the shot injures the Alien: Injured, in Hospital slot 1, still detained. Jail slot 1 is empty.
Episode: admitted in Round 4, due at the end of Round 5.
visibility: Public: Injured, in Hospital, detained. A patient's clothes with a detention marker, not a prisoner's.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Captain hurt inside Command Room goes straight to Hospital
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Cracker. In Round 3 the Cracker moves out to Room A (slot 1).
sequence: Round 4. Undercover, own turn: registers a shot at the Cracker, who is in Room A.
Later in Round 4 the Cracker moves into Command Room.
The round resolves.

state: The shot resolves: where the target is at resolution does not matter.
The Cracker is Injured, loses the title at once and is in Hospital slot 1.
No published state shows the Cracker in Room A or Room B on the way.
An election is held before Round 5.
visibility: Public: the injury and the loss of the title.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Everybody who can be hurt in one round has a bed
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 3: Supplier arms the Cracker and the Alien. Nobody has attacked yet.
sequence: Round 4, Room A: the Blue Disabler's Blackout hits the Supplier; Undercover shoots the Blue Disabler; the Cracker shoots Undercover; the Alien shoots the Cracker. Room B: the Red Disabler's Blackout hits the Insider.

state: Five players are Injured in one stage. Every registered attack resolves although several of its actors are hurt in the same stage.
All are in Hospital, in positions 1 to 5. Nobody waits in a room.
Hospital has 8 positions; 3 are free.
visibility: Public: every patient in Hospital.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

notes: Which player holds which position is the question of SLOT-03 (NV-F-03).

cases.title: Rescued in the following round
preconditions: As HSP-01 at the start of Round 3.
sequence: Round 3. Cracker, own turn, in Room A: registers a Rescue of Undercover, who is in Hospital.
Round 3 resolves.

state: Rescue stage: Undercover is Healthy. The episode is cleared.
No death applies.
Placement: Undercover returns to Room A, the room they remember, in slot 3, the lowest free slot.
The Cracker has one Rescue left.
visibility: The recovery is public and comes from the Hospital. Nothing points to the Cracker.
timing: The Rescue stage is before the due deaths in the same resolution.

cases.title: A Rescue registered in the round of the injury
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2.
sequence: Cracker, own turn (second): registers a Rescue of Undercover, who is Healthy and in the same room. The Cracker then moves to Room B, leaving Room A slot 1 empty.
Blue Disabler: requests a Blackout and in darkness selects Room A slot 3 (Undercover).

state: Attack stage: Undercover is Injured, and by the letter of the packet in Hospital from that instant. Rescue stage: Undercover is Healthy. No episode remains.
Placement: Undercover returns to Room A as a healed player and takes slot 1, the lowest free position, not slot 3.
The Rescue and the Blackout use are spent.
visibility: Recommended reading (NV-F-08): the recovery is shown, as the packet shows medical recoveries, without its source. The table sees that Undercover was hurt and healed in this round; here the new position shows that something happened anyway.
The table learns that Undercover was attacked, and that the Cracker stood in Undercover's room when the Rescue was registered. Today it sees nothing of such a round.
No payload names the Cracker or the Blue Disabler.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: Only the resulting change is shown, as the kept rule R-ACT-08 has it: Undercover appears in slot 1, and no outcome is shown.
If nobody changes place within a stage (the answer suggested under NV-F-01), Undercover stays in slot 3, and whether the recovery is shown is the only question left.

cases.title: A Rescue that heals nobody is spent and moves no deadline
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures Undercover. Due at the end of Round 2.
sequence: Round 2. Cracker, own turn: registers a Rescue of the Alien, who is Healthy.
Round 2 resolves.

state: The Rescue heals nobody and is spent: one left.
Undercover dies on schedule at the end of Round 2.
visibility: Public: the death.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Healed and hurt again: a new episode with its own deadline
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 1: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures Undercover (Room A slot 4).
sequence: Round 2. The Cracker rescues Undercover.
Round 3. Supplier arms the Alien and the Cracker.
Round 4. The Alien registers a shot at Undercover.

state: End of Round 2: Undercover is Healthy, back in Room A slot 4. The first episode is cleared.
End of Round 4: Undercover is Injured again. A new episode: admitted in Round 4, due at the end of Round 5.
The first episode's deadline plays no part.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A vote against a patient records detention and moves nobody, and the deadline stands
preconditions: As HSP-01 at the start of Round 3.
sequence: Round 3. Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name Undercover, the patient.
Round 3 resolves with no Rescue.

state: At V Undercover is detained and stays in Hospital slot 1. Nobody enters Jail.
At the end of Round 3 Undercover dies on schedule.
visibility: Public: detained, in Hospital.
timing: Detention neither shortens nor lengthens the episode.

cases.title: A detained patient who is healed returns to Jail
preconditions: As HSP-01 at the start of Round 3.
sequence: Round 3. Cracker, own turn: registers a Rescue of Undercover.
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name Undercover.
Round 3 resolves.

state: Rescue stage: Undercover is Healthy.
Placement: Undercover goes to Jail slot 1, still detained. Not to Room A.
Hospital slot 1 is empty.
visibility: Public: the recovery, then a prisoner in Jail.
timing: In placement, healed detained patients are returned to Jail before free players are returned to rooms.

cases.title: The Cracker as a free patient
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 2: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures the Cracker (Room A slot 1).
sequence: Round 3. Cracker, own turn, in Hospital: registers a Rescue of themself.

state: Accepted: an Injured Cracker may Rescue themself, and nobody else.
Rescue stage: the Cracker is Healthy, and returns to Room A slot 1.
One Rescue left.
A Rescue of any other patient by the Injured Cracker would be refused.
visibility: Public: the recovery.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The Cracker as a detained patient
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4: Undercover registers a shot at the Cracker; the vote jails the Cracker; the shot injures them. The Cracker is in Hospital, detained, due at the end of Round 5.
sequence: Round 5. Cracker, own turn: registers a Rescue of themself.

state: Refused: a Jailed player has no Main Action, and being in Hospital does not change that.
At the end of Round 5 the Cracker dies.
visibility: Public: the death.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A patient of Round 4: Round 5 is the whole rescue opportunity
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4: Undercover's shot injures the Alien. Admitted in Round 4; due at the end of Round 5.
sequence: Round 5, one match: nobody rescues.
Round 5, another match: the Cracker rescues the Alien.

state: First match: after the Rescue stage of Round 5 the Alien dies. At the Round 5 check the Alien adds nothing to Blue Power and cannot win with Blue.
Second match: the Alien is Healthy and back in Room A before the Round 5 check; they add one to Blue Power.
visibility: Public.
timing: Rescue, then due deaths, then placement, then the victory check, all inside the resolution of Round 5.

cases.title: Hurt in Round 5: no death, no extra round
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 5.
sequence: Undercover registers a shot at the Alien. Round 5 resolves.

state: The Alien is Injured, in Hospital, alive.
No death is due for this episode. No Round 6, no extra Rescue.
At the Round 5 check the Alien adds nothing to Blue Power.
If there is no winner the showdown follows, and the Alien takes part from Hospital.
visibility: Public. No countdown is shown that could run out.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Two patients of one round and one Rescue a round
preconditions: The end of SLOT-03: the Blue Disabler and the Alien were both admitted in Round 4.
sequence: Round 5. Cracker, own turn: registers a Rescue of the Alien.

state: The Alien is healed and returns to Room A.
The Blue Disabler dies at the end of Round 5: a Rescue is a Main Action, one a turn.
Of the patients of one round, the Rescue of the following round can save one.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Protection does not stop a Hospital death
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker (active from Round 2). In the same round the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures the Cracker: a pending Protection blocks nothing.
sequence: Round 2. Nobody rescues, the Cracker included. Round 2 resolves.

state: The Cracker dies at the end of Round 2, holding an active, unused Protection.
The Protection is not used up by the death.
visibility: No room event.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A patient's own turn
preconditions: The end of SLOT-03: the Blue Disabler and the Alien are patients in Hospital. Round 5.
sequence: The Alien, own turn: requests a Hack with the Blue Disabler; tries to activate the Clone; sends a move.
The Alien votes in the Jail vote.

state: The Hack is accepted: the two are in the same place.
The activation and the move are refused.
The ballot is accepted.
visibility: The Hack's pair is public from its first stage.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A healed player whose room has filled up goes to the other room
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures Undercover (Room A slot 3).
sequence: Round 2. The Insider moves to Room A and takes slot 3. Room A holds five.
Cracker, own turn, in Room A: registers a Rescue of Undercover.
Round 2 resolves.

state: Undercover is healed. The room they remember, Room A, is full.
Undercover goes to Room B and takes slot 1, the lowest free position.
Undercover now remembers Room B.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Captain hurt and healed in one round has lost the title and is seated in a room
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Alien. In Round 3 the Alien moves out to Room A and takes slot 4.
sequence: Round 4. Cracker, own turn (second): registers a Rescue of the Alien, who is Healthy and in the same room.
Undercover, own turn (fifth): registers a shot at the Alien.
