The Alien then moves into Command Room.
The round resolves.

state: Attack stage: the Alien is Injured and loses the title at once.
Rescue stage: the Alien is Healthy. The title does not come back.
Placement: no longer Captain, the Alien is seated in Room A, the room they remember, in slot 4, the lowest free position. Command Room is empty.
An election is held before Round 5.
visibility: Public: the loss of the title and the Alien's place. What the table sees of the injury and the recovery is NV-F-08.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Captain Eliminated by two shots registered in a room, after stepping into Command Room
preconditions: Layout ARMS. The election after Round 1 elects the Alien. Round 3: the Alien moves out to Room A and takes slot 5; Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler.
sequence: Round 4. The Cracker and Undercover each register a shot at the Alien, who is in Room A.
The Alien then moves into Command Room.
The round resolves.

state: The first shot injures the Alien, who loses the title at once and, by the letter of the packet, goes straight to Hospital. The second eliminates the Alien.
After the resolution the body is seated like a returning player, as the owner decided for this case on 11 October (R-CAP-24): in Room A, the room the Alien was last in, slot 5. Command Room is empty.
visibility: Public: the Alien Eliminated, and where the body is.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If the transfer to Hospital at the first hit is taken to decide where this body lies too, as it does for every other player, the body stays in Hospital (NV-F-01).

cases.title: A detained patient and a Hack
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 4: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures the Cracker; Undercover registers a shot at the Alien; the vote jails the Alien; the shot injures them.
The Cracker is a free patient and the Alien a detained patient, both in Hospital.
sequence: Round 5. The Alien, own turn: requests a Hack with the Cracker.

state: Recommended reading (NV-F-12): accepted. A Jailed player may take part in a Hack where the other rules allow it, and the two are in the same place.
visibility: If it is accepted, the pair is public like any other.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: Refused, if "medical detention does not create additional Hospital actions" means that a detained patient can do no more than a prisoner in Jail could, who could not have reached the Cracker.

cases.title: A Protection blocks: who is told, and what
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. It is active from Round 2.
sequence: Round 2. The Blue Disabler requests a Blackout and in darkness selects Room A slot 1 (Cracker).

state: Blocked. The Cracker is Healthy in Room A slot 1. The Protection is used up. The Blackout use is spent.
visibility: A room event goes to the seats that were in Room A when the attack was applied: the Cracker, the Blue Disabler, Undercover, the Alien and the Red Disabler.
It names the affected player and says ATTACK BLOCKED. It carries no cause, grantor, attacker, direction, role or counter.
The Cracker learns that they were attacked and that something stopped it, and not what.
Undercover also reads, privately as before, that the Protection was used up.
timing: Delivered after the whole resolution, not when the single attack is applied.

cases.title: A Clone blocks: the same event
preconditions: Layout MIX, played twice. Run one: in Round 2 the Alien activates the Clone and holds no Protection. Run two: in Round 1 Undercover grants Protection to the Alien, and the Alien never activates the Clone.
sequence: Round 2, both runs. The Blue Disabler requests a Blackout and in darkness selects Room A slot 4 (Alien).

state: Blocked in both runs. The Alien is Healthy.
Run one: the Clone stays active. Run two: the Protection is used up.
visibility: Every seat of Room A other than the Alien and Undercover reads the same payloads in both runs, at every moment of the match up to this point.
The event has the same fields, the same values and the same form of identity in both.
The Alien and Undercover differ only in what was already private to them.
timing: The same instants in both runs.

cases.title: Outside the room nothing is shown
preconditions: DEF-01, and beside it a run in which the Blue Disabler asks for nothing in Round 2.
sequence: Both runs resolve Round 2.

state: The public state is the same in both runs.
visibility: The seats of Room B (the Insider, the Supplier, the Hacker), a host without a seat and the shared display read the same payloads in both runs at every moment.
They get no event, badge, count or sound, and no revision of their view that the other run lacks.
timing: The same instants in both runs.

cases.title: Entering the room later, or reconnecting, shows nothing of it
preconditions: The end of DEF-01.
sequence: Round 3. The Alien moves to Room B; the Insider then moves to Room A.
Undercover, who was in Room A for the block, closes the app and opens it again.

state: The Insider is in Room A and receives nothing about Round 2.
Undercover gets the current state and no replay.
visibility: Neither can read from any payload that a block happened in the room.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A room member who is hurt later in the same stage still gets the event
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. It is active from Round 2.
Round 4. Turn order by player number.
sequence: The Blue Disabler (third) requests a Blackout; Undercover (fifth) registers a shot at the Alien.
In darkness the Blue Disabler selects Room A slot 1 (Cracker).

state: The Blackout is applied first and blocked. Then the shot injures the Alien.
The Alien was in Room A when the block was applied and is a recipient, although the event reaches them in Hospital.
visibility: The Alien reads the room event.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A room member who is hurt earlier in the same stage
preconditions: As DEF-05, but the turn order of Round 4 has Undercover before the Blue Disabler.
sequence: The same commands.

state: The shot is applied first and injures the Alien. Then the Blackout is blocked.
Recommended reading: who is in the room is fixed once, when the attack stage begins. The Alien is a recipient, exactly as in DEF-05.
visibility: Under the recommended reading no seat can tell DEF-05 from DEF-06 by what it received.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: By the letter of the sentence on recipients: the Alien was already in Hospital in the working state when the block was applied, and is not a recipient. What the Alien received then says which of the two attackers acted first.

cases.title: The target was jailed after the shot was registered
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. Round 3: Supplier arms the Alien and the Blue Disabler.
sequence: Round 4. The Alien registers a shot at the Cracker.
Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Cracker.

state: At V the Cracker is in Jail. The shot is applied there and blocked.
The Cracker is Healthy, in Jail.
visibility: The room is the one the target is in when the attack is applied: Jail. The Cracker is the only recipient.
Room A gets nothing. The Alien, who fired, is told only that the shot was completed.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A Captain blocked inside Command Room
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. It is active from Round 2.
The election after Round 1 elects the Cracker. In Round 3 the Cracker moves out to Room A.
sequence: Round 4. Undercover registers a shot at the Cracker in Room A. The Cracker then moves into Command Room.

state: The shot is applied in Command Room and blocked. The Cracker is Healthy and stays Captain.
visibility: The Cracker alone receives the room event.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: An Eliminated seat that lies in the room of a block
preconditions: Layout ARMS. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Supplier. Nobody attacks the Supplier in Rounds 2 to 4.

The election after Round 1 elects the Alien. Round 3: the Alien moves out to Room A and takes slot 5; Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler. Round 4: the Cracker and Undercover each register a shot at the Alien in Room A, and the Alien then moves into Command Room. The Alien is Eliminated, and the body is seated in Room A slot 5 (HSP-20).
sequence: Round 5. The Blue Disabler requests a Blackout and in darkness selects Room A slot 3 (Supplier).

state: Blocked; the Protection is used up.
visibility: The room event goes to the seats in Room A when the stage began: the Cracker, the Blue Disabler, the Supplier, Undercover, and the Alien's Eliminated seat.
As the packet says of retained Eliminated occupants, the Alien's seat gains no other room's events.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If the transfer to Hospital at the first hit is taken to decide where the Alien's body lies too (HSP-20, NV-F-01), no body lies in Room A and the Alien's seat is not a recipient.

cases.title: Nothing in the delivery follows the attackers
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1: Undercover grants Protection to the Cracker. It is active from Round 2.
Round 4, played twice. The Alien activates the Clone on their turn in both runs.
sequence: Run one: the Blue Disabler's Blackout hits slot 1 (Cracker); Undercover shoots the Alien.
Run two: the Blue Disabler's Blackout hits slot 4 (Alien); Undercover shoots the Cracker.

state: Both attacks are blocked in both runs. The same two players are affected.
The order in which the two blocks were applied is the reverse in run two.
visibility: The Cracker, the Alien and the Red Disabler read the same payloads in both runs: the same two events, in the same order, with the same times.
Event identities do not count attacks or carry a resolution index.
timing: The same instants in both runs.

cases.title: What an attacker is told
preconditions: DEF-01 and DEF-07.
sequence: The round resolves.

state: The attacker's own record says registered, and later completed. It never says blocked.
In DEF-01 the Blue Disabler is in the target's room and receives the room event like every member.
In DEF-07 the Alien is not, and learns nothing more.
visibility: As stated.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A hit that is not blocked
preconditions: BLK-02 and BLK-24.
sequence: The round resolves.

state: The health and place of the player who was hit are public.
No audience gets a cause, a source, a room of origin or a direction.
Two hits on one player are two outcomes.
visibility: The same public facts for a seat in the room, a seat outside it and the shared display.
timing: The times of the outcomes do not follow the order or the arrival of the hidden actions.

cases.title: A host who holds a seat reads what that seat reads, and no more
preconditions: DEF-01, played twice. In one match the host holds the Alien's seat, in Room A. In the other the host holds the Insider's seat, in Room B.
sequence: Round 2 resolves.

state: First match: the host reads the room event as the Alien's seat does, and nothing of any other seat's private view: not Undercover's record that the Protection was used up.
Second match: the host reads what the Insider's seat reads, with the host's own controls: nothing of the block.
visibility: Being host gives no audience of its own.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: From the closing of the vote to the resolution, with a Captain jailed
preconditions: Layout MIX. The election after Round 1 elects the Insider, who is placed in Command Room and stays there.
sequence: Round 2. Jail vote: 4 of 8 ballots name the Insider. It closes at V.

state: At V: the Insider is Jailed, loses the title and is in Jail slot 1. Command Room is empty.
Then the result, then the window, then the resolution.
An election is held before Round 3.
visibility: The tally is public for the whole result. No individual ballot is shown.
timing: Result [V, V + 5 s). Window from W ≥ V + 5 s: lit [W, W + 5 s), dark [W + 5 s, W + 15 s). The round resolves at X ≥ W + 15 s.

cases.title: A closure that is delivered late takes no time from the next phase
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. The Blue Disabler has requested a Blackout.
sequence: The Jail vote closes at V.
The closure of the result is delivered three seconds late and commits at V + 8 s.
The closure of the window is delivered two seconds late and commits at V + 25 s.

state: The window opens at V + 8 s and is whole: lit [V + 8 s, V + 13 s), dark [V + 13 s, V + 23 s).
A selection at V + 22 s is accepted. A selection at V + 24 s is refused.
The round resolves at V + 25 s. The phase that follows gets its full time from then.
visibility: Every phone shows the times the server gives, not times it counted itself.
timing: Each phase runs its full length from the commit that opened it.

cases.title: What is accepted between the closing of the vote and the resolution
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 5. The Blue Disabler has requested a Blackout. A Captain is in office and a prisoner is in Jail. The Clone is unused.
sequence: During the result: a move, a ballot, a Clone activation, RELEASE, EJECT, a Code.
During the window: the same six, and the Blue Disabler's selection in darkness.

state: During the result every one of the six is refused.
During the window the selection is accepted and the first five are refused.

The Code during the window is accepted: the Hacker may enter it at any time in Round 5 before the round's resolution closes (R-ROLE-15), and the packet, which closes the window to movement, to the Clone and to the Captain's commands, does not close it to the Code.
visibility: Private refusals.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If the window is meant to be like the result, the Code is refused in it too. The packet does not say so.

cases.title: Election and runoff results
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1 has resolved.
sequence: The election ties between the Insider and the Cracker.
The runoff elects the Insider.

state: A five-second result after the election; a runoff of sixty seconds; a five-second result after the runoff.
The Insider is Captain and in Command Room from the closing of the runoff.
The first turn of Round 2 has its full sixty seconds.
visibility: Each result shows totals only.
timing: Election 60 s, result 5 s, runoff 60 s, result 5 s, each from its own opening.

cases.title: Who is in the Chamber is public
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. The Insider requests a Hack with the Supplier on their own turn.
sequence: The Insider's turn ends and the declaration stage opens.

state: The pair and the stage are public facts of the Hack. That much the packet states.
Recommended reading (NV-F-11): from the opening of the declaration stage, through the result and the conversation.
Before the declaration stage the request is private.
visibility: Every seat, the host and the shared display read both participants and the stage.
This replaces the rule of the declared-Hack ruleset, under which only the two read who the partner is.
timing: From the opening of the declaration stage to the end of the conversation, under the recommended reading.

otherOutcome: The pair becomes public with the entrance, in the result stage; during the declaration the table reads only the initiator, as today.

cases.title: What is claimed stays between the two
preconditions: Layout MIX, played twice. Round 1. The Cracker requests a Hack with Undercover.
sequence: Run one: Undercover declares Blue four seconds into the declaration stage.
Run two: Undercover declares Red at the same instant.

state: Both declarations are accepted: Undercover may bluff.
visibility: The Cracker and Undercover read the declared side for the five seconds of the result.
Every other audience reads the same payloads in both runs: the pair and the stage, no claim, no sign of whether one was made truthfully.
After the conversation the two no longer read the claim as a live result.
timing: The same instants in both runs.

cases.title: Fifteen, five, sixty
preconditions: As HCK-01. The declaration stage opens at D.
sequence: The Supplier declares at D + 4 s.
No phone sends anything else, and none acknowledges an animation.

state: Declaration: closes at D + 4 s. Without a declaration it would close at D + 15 s.
Result: five seconds. Entrance and door are inside it.
Conversation: sixty seconds from its own opening.
Then the next player's turn, with its full sixty seconds.
visibility: The private result is readable for all five seconds: the entrance does not cover it.
timing: Result [D + 4 s, D + 9 s). Conversation [D + 9 s, D + 69 s), when both closures are delivered on time.
No stage waits for a client.

cases.title: No declaration
preconditions: As HCK-01.
sequence: The Supplier declares nothing for fifteen seconds.

state: The result says No side declared. No side is made up.
Then five seconds of result and sixty of conversation, as in HCK-03.
visibility: The two participants read the result. The pair stays public.
timing: Result [D + 15 s, D + 20 s). Conversation [D + 20 s, D + 80 s).

cases.title: The Chamber is not a room
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1. The Cracker requests a Hack with Undercover on their own turn. The Cracker is in Room A slot 1 and Undercover in Room A slot 3.
sequence: During the conversation Undercover moves to Room B.

state: Accepted: Undercover is in Room B slot 4, and Room A slot 3 is empty.
Through all three stages both participants keep their room and position unless they move themselves.
No room gains or loses a place because of the Hack. Nobody becomes harder or easier to target, vote for or move next to.
visibility: The move is public when it is made.
At the end of the conversation each figure is shown at the position the server gives then: the Cracker in Room A slot 1, Undercover in Room B.
timing: The exit is not a phase and has no time of its own.

cases.title: A declaration deadline that is delivered late
preconditions: As HCK-04.
sequence: The closure of the declaration stage commits at D + 17 s. The closure of the result commits at D + 24 s.

state: Result [D + 17 s, D + 22 s): five full seconds from its opening.
Conversation [D + 24 s, D + 84 s): sixty full seconds from its opening.
visibility: Phones show the server's times.
timing: As stated.

cases.title: The conversation itself
preconditions: A table of people, during a Hack's conversation stage.
sequence: The two step aside and talk.

state: They can talk for sixty seconds without the others hearing.
The app carries no voice, records nothing, and shows no microphone or recording sign.
visibility: The app does not, and cannot, show that nobody overheard.
timing: Sixty seconds on the shared clock.

cases.title: Who may start a Hack, and with whom
preconditions: Layout MIX. Round 1.
sequence: The Insider requests a Hack with the Cracker, who is in the other room; with themself; with the Supplier.
Later in the round two more players each request a Hack.
In Round 2 the Insider requests another.

state: Other room: refused. Self: refused. The Supplier: accepted.
The second Hack of the round is accepted; the third is refused.
The Insider's second is refused: one a match.
visibility: A refused request is private.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A declaration at the instant the stage ends
preconditions: As HCK-01. The declaration stage opens at D.
sequence: The Supplier declares at D + 15 s exactly, and nothing before.

state: Refused: the stage is over at its deadline.
The result says No side declared.
visibility: The two participants read the result.
timing: A declaration is accepted in [D, D + 15 s).

cases.title: Everybody stays where they are
preconditions: Layout MIX. Nobody was hurt in Rounds 1 to 4. The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jailed the Insider and the Supplier. The election before Round 2 elected the Hacker, who is in Command Room. Neither command was used. No Code was submitted.
Round 5: Undercover's shot injures the Alien, who is in Hospital when the round has resolved.
At the Round 5 check Red Power is 3 and Blue Power is 2; no Code; nobody Eliminated. No condition is met.
sequence: The showdown opens.

state: Nobody is moved. Rooms and positions are what they were: prisoners in Jail, the Alien in Hospital, the Hacker in Command Room.
There is no Final Zone.
Every player who is not Eliminated has one special shot: the prisoners and the patient too.
visibility: A shared scene is laid over the board; the board under it is unchanged.
timing: One window of sixty seconds for every participant.

cases.title: Any other survivor can be named, from anywhere
preconditions: The state of SHW-01.
sequence: The Blue Disabler (Room A) names the Hacker, who is inside Command Room.
The Insider (Jail) names Undercover (Room A).
The Alien (Hospital) names the Supplier (Jail).
Undercover names themself.

state: The first three are accepted: room, Jail, injury and Command Room make no difference to a special shot.
The fourth is refused: the target is another survivor.
visibility: Targets are private until the batch resolves.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: The batch: all registered first, a dead shooter's shot still fired
preconditions: The state of SHW-01. The Round 5 turn order is by player number.
sequence: Undercover (fifth) names the Alien. The Alien (seventh) names Undercover. Nobody else shoots.
The window closes.

state: In the Round 5 order: Undercover's shot eliminates the Alien, who was Injured.
The Alien's shot, registered before, still resolves: Undercover is Injured and is in Hospital.
No Rescue stage follows and no Hospital deadline runs.
Final check: Red Power 2, Blue Power 2; no Code; neither side eliminated. The match is a Draw.
visibility: Outcomes are shown after the whole batch. The Alien's faction is shown with the final result.
timing: Nothing resolves before the window closes.

cases.title: A Protection granted in Round 5 is not a defence in the showdown
preconditions: Layout MIX. Nobody was hurt in Rounds 1 to 4. The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jailed the Insider and the Supplier. The election before Round 2 elected the Hacker, who is in Command Room. Neither command was used. No Code was submitted.
Round 5: Undercover grants Protection to the Blue Disabler. Nobody is hurt in Round 5.
At the Round 5 check Power is 3 and 3: no winner.
sequence: In the showdown the Hacker names the Blue Disabler.

state: Not blocked: a grant of Round 5 never becomes active.
The Blue Disabler is Injured and is in Hospital.
visibility: No room event.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A patient of Round 5 whom nobody names lives through the showdown
preconditions: The state of SHW-01.
sequence: Nobody names the Alien. The window closes.

state: The Alien is Injured and alive at the final check.
Nothing kills them: no deadline runs after the last normal round.
visibility: Public.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Two special shots at one Healthy player
preconditions: The state of SHW-01.
sequence: Undercover and the Hacker both name the Blue Disabler.

state: The first shot in the Round 5 order injures; the second eliminates.
By the letter of the packet the body is in Hospital, where the first hit had put the player (NV-F-01).
visibility: Two outcomes.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

otherOutcome: If a player eliminated in the stage that first hurt them keeps their position (NV-F-01), the body lies in Room A slot 2.

cases.title: A block in the showdown
preconditions: Layout MIX. Nobody was hurt in Rounds 1 to 4. The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jailed the Insider and the Supplier. The election before Round 2 elected the Hacker, who is in Command Room. Neither command was used. No Code was submitted.
Round 3: Undercover grants Protection to the Blue Disabler (active from Round 4). Nobody attacks the Blue Disabler in Rounds 4 and 5.
At the Round 5 check Power is 3 and 3: no winner.
sequence: In the showdown the Hacker names the Blue Disabler.

state: Blocked. The Protection is used up. The Blue Disabler is Healthy.
visibility: A room event for the seats of the Blue Disabler's actual room, Room A. The Hacker, in Command Room, receives nothing.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: A match that ends at the checkpoint of Round 2
preconditions: Layout MIX.
sequence: Round 1: the Blue Disabler's Blackout injures the Red Disabler; the Red Disabler's Blackout injures Undercover. The vote jails the Hacker. The election elects the Insider.
Round 2: Insider, own turn: EJECT. Nobody rescues. Round 2 resolves.

state: During Round 2 the Hacker is Eliminated by the EJECT.
At the end of Round 2 Undercover and the Red Disabler die in Hospital.
At the checkpoint of Round 2 every Red player is Eliminated and a Blue player is Healthy: Blue wins, and the Alien with Blue.
visibility: Result, roles and Code at the checkpoint of Round 2.
timing: No match can end at an earlier checkpoint: Round 1 has no Captain and no Hospital death, its attacks can eliminate one player at most, and nothing but elimination ends a match before Round 5.

cases.title: The Alien alone
preconditions: Layout ARMS. The election after Round 1 elects the Alien, who stays in Command Room. In Round 2 the Red Disabler moves to Room A. The Cracker, the Blue Disabler, the Supplier, Undercover and the Red Disabler are then in Room A.
sequence: The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jail the Insider and the Hacker.
Round 3: the Alien, own turn: EJECT. Supplier arms the Cracker and the Blue Disabler.

Round 4: the Blue Disabler's Blackout hits the Supplier and their shot hits Undercover; the Red Disabler's Blackout hits the Cracker; Undercover shoots the Red Disabler; the Cracker shoots the Blue Disabler.
Round 5: nobody rescues. Round 5 resolves.

state: Round 3: the Insider and the Hacker are Eliminated. A Blue and a Red player are gone; both sides still have members.
Round 4: five players are Injured, every remaining Blue and Red player among them.
End of Round 5: all of them die in one stage. Both sides had a member before it and neither has one after.
The Alien is not Eliminated and wins alone.
visibility: The result at the Round 5 checkpoint.
timing: Nothing of its own: the round keeps the schedule of BLK-01.

cases.title: Five rounds, a showdown without a shot, a draw
preconditions: Layout MIX. Nobody was hurt in Rounds 1 to 4. The votes of Rounds 1 and 2 jailed the Insider and the Supplier. The election before Round 2 elected the Hacker, who is in Command Room. Neither command was used. No Code was submitted.
Nobody is hurt in Round 5.
sequence: Five rounds are played to their ends, each with its vote, result and window.
The showdown opens. Nobody names a target. Its window closes.

state: Round 5 check: Blue Power 3 and Red Power 3. Blue is not stronger; no Code; no winner.
After the showdown nothing has changed: the match is a Draw.
Every player is where they were when Round 5 resolved.
visibility: The Draw, the roles and the Code when the showdown has resolved.
timing: Five windows of fifteen seconds were run, one in each round, though nobody asked for a Blackout.
